title: Mission Performance: Automatic and Adaptive Race Pace Progression for Autonomous Racing
abstract: arXiv:2609.12292v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we describe the Mission Performance module implemented for a fully autonomous racing car to automatically manage the longitudinal, lateral, and combined performances, aiming to speedup the laptime progression while assuring safety. Motivated by the difficulty and risks of applying the real-time estimation of the grip to critical modules like the motion planner and controller, the Mission Performance guides these modules adapting their target performance instead of changing the vehicle model parameters. The module is formed by pre-defined progressions to warm up the tires at the beginning of a run. Then, the system continuously monitors safety and vehicle dynamics metrics on a per-sector basis to adaptively reduce, maintain, or increase the performance levels for each sector, progressively converging toward the maximum allowed value. The solution's effectiveness is demonstrated on the EAV-25, a fully autonomous Dallara Su

translated_title: 任务性能：面向自动驾驶赛车的自动自适应比赛节奏推进
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们描述了为全自动驾驶赛车实现的任务性能模块，该模块能够自动管理纵向、横向以及综合性能，旨在加速单圈时间的提升，同时确保安全。由于将抓地力的实时估计应用于运动规划器和控制器等关键模块存在困难和风险，任务性能模块通过调整这些模块的目标性能来引导它们，而不是改变车辆模型参数。该模块由预定义的推进程序组成，用于在运行开始时预热轮胎。随后，系统按赛段持续监测安全和车辆动力学指标，以自适应地降低、维持或提高每个赛段的性能水平，逐步收敛到允许的最大值。该解决方案的有效性在EAV-25（一辆全自动驾驶的Dallara超级赛车）上得到了验证。
tldr: 本文提出了一种用于全自动驾驶赛车的任务性能模块，通过按赛段自适应调整目标性能（而非修改车辆模型参数），在确保安全的前提下加速单圈时间的提升。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a Mission Performance module for fully autonomous racing cars that adaptively adjusts target performance on a per-sector basis, rather than modifying vehicle model parameters, to accelerate lap time progression while ensuring safety.
